cases.location: White orbs in the sky moving then fading out

cases.long_description: On 01-22-2025 between approximately 0440 hours and 0550 hours I observed two white orbs in the eastern sky. One orb would slowly appear along with a second, which would also slowly appear. They would move slowly in all directions before turning to a red light and then slowly fading out one at a time. At the end, I observed up to 6 white orbs in a diagonal formation. Think of hands on a clock at 11 o'clock and 4 o'clock and that is how the orbs were lined up. They hovered there for about 10 minutes when one of the orbs moved to the south, stopped, and then moved back to the north. All of the orbs then slowly faded out one at a time. The ground temperature around this time was -7 degrees Fahrenheit with a wind chill at -25 degrees Fahrenheit. There also did not appear to be any clouds. Air traffic from commercial planes were observed in the area and noted with their flashing strobe lights. These were not flares as the objects would descend, ascend, move horizontally, etc. The images attached show how clear the night was, the orbs stacked, and a close up of the stacked orbs. The videos attached show how they appear and slowly fade out. One of the videos shows a known aircraft to the north of the orbs as shown with the flashing strobe.

cases.location: Line if lights moving fast into distance

cases.long_description: I was driving south on NY route 281 when I looked out my window across the road towards a large grocery store distribution center in case any workers were attempting to cross the road. I noticed some bright stars in my periphery. I saw what looked like a planet in the east / north east high up in the sky above and to the left of the distribution center. To the right of that was a line of about 6-12 star-lights shining extremely brightly for the predawn sky. The line started high in the sky slightly above and to the right of the planet and went downward at a slight angle and at even spacing. At first i thought it was part of a constellation but after searching for about a minute i couldn't see any other stars in the sky. I then assumed it must have been a reflection of something in the car. So i moved my head around to see if i could determine the origin and turn the lights off. However while i saw the reflection of the dashboard lights in the window move around as i moved my head the line of star-lights didn't move at all. Finding this curious i took out my phone to take a picture. When i next looked out my window the star-lights had moved away and towards the south east getting dimmer over the course of about 30-60 seconds until they were completely gone.
